points.title: 王子教育
points.description: 腓特烈出生于柏林，是普鲁士国王腓特烈·威廉一世的儿子。童年时期接受了严格的军事教育，但同时也接受了良好的艺术和哲学教育。他与父亲关系紧张，尤其是对父亲的军事专制和粗鲁举止感到反感。这段时期，腓特烈秘密学习音乐和法语，并与伏尔泰等启蒙思想家通信，形成了自己的人文主义思想。1730年，他试图与挚友汉斯·赫尔曼·冯·卡特逃往英国，但被抓获，面临处决风险，最终在母亲干预下被赦免，但被迫目睹卡特被处决。
points.descriptionEn: Frederick was born in Berlin as the son of King Frederick William I of Prussia. During his childhood, he received strict military education but also received excellent artistic and philosophical education. He had a tense relationship with his father, particularly反感 to his father's military despotism and rough manners. During this period, Frederick secretly studied music and French and corresponded with Enlightenment thinkers like Voltaire, forming his own humanistic ideas. In 1730, he attempted to flee to England with his close friend Hans Hermann von Katte, but was captured, facing the risk of execution. Ultimately, he was pardoned through his mother's intervention, but was forced to witness Katte's execution.

points.title: 流放岁月
points.description: 在父亲去世前，腓特烈被流放到莱茵斯贝格城堡，远离柏林的政治中心。这段时期，他沉浸在艺术、音乐和哲学中，与伏尔泰等启蒙思想家交往密切。他在这里创作了《反马基雅维利》一书，批判马基雅维利的政治思想，主张君主应遵循道德和正义原则。这段流放经历使腓特烈有时间反思自己的政治理念，并形成了独特的统治哲学，为他后来的统治奠定了思想基础。同时，他也在此组建了自己的小型军队，积累了军事经验。
points.descriptionEn: Before his father's death, Frederick was exiled to Rheinsberg Castle, away from the political center of Berlin. During this period, he immersed himself in art, music, and philosophy, and had close contacts with Enlightenment thinkers such as Voltaire. Here he wrote the book 'Anti-Machiavel', criticizing Machiavelli's political ideas and advocating that monarchs should follow moral and just principles. This exile period allowed Frederick time to reflect on his political philosophy and form a unique ruling philosophy, laying the ideological foundation for his later reign. At the same time, he also formed his own small army here, accumulating military experience.

points.title: 征战岁月
points.description: 1740年，腓特烈继位为普鲁士国王，随即发动了第一次西里西亚战争，从奥地利手中夺取了富庶的西里西亚地区。随后，他参与了奥地利王位继承战争、七年战争等一系列重大军事冲突。在七年战争中，普鲁士一度面临被多个欧洲强国围剿的危机，腓特烈以卓越的军事才能和坚韧的意志力，带领普鲁士军队多次以少胜多，最终保住了国家独立和西里西亚。这一时期，腓特烈展现了非凡的军事才能，被誉为'军事天才'，普鲁士也由此崛起为欧洲军事强国。这些战争虽然带来了领土扩张，但也给普鲁士和整个欧洲带来了巨大的人力物力损失。
points.descriptionEn: In 1740, Frederick ascended the Prussian throne and immediately launched the First Silesian War, seizing the wealthy region of Silesia from Austria. Subsequently, he participated in major military conflicts such as the War of Austrian Succession and the Seven Years' War. During the Seven Years' War, Prussia faced the crisis of being besieged by multiple European powers. With outstanding military talent and strong willpower, Frederick led the Prussian army to win many battles against superior forces, ultimately preserving national independence and Silesia. During this period, Frederick demonstrated extraordinary military talent and was hailed as a 'military genius', and Prussia rose to become a European military power. Although these wars brought territorial expansion, they also caused enormous human and material losses to Prussia and the entire Europe.

points.title: 改革统治
points.description: 七年战争后，腓特烈将注意力转向国内改革。他在波茨坦推行了一系列现代化改革，包括废除酷刑、改革司法系统、促进宗教宽容、鼓励农业和工业发展。他建立了普鲁士科学院，支持科学研究和文化发展。腓特烈还推行了义务教育制度，成为世界上最早实施义务教育的国家之一。他亲自巡视各地，了解民情，并经常以'国家第一仆人'自居。这一时期，普鲁士的经济和文化得到显著发展，行政效率提高，社会更加稳定。腓特烈的开明专制统治模式成为欧洲各国的典范，他的'启蒙专制'理念影响了整个欧洲的政治发展。
points.descriptionEn: After the Seven Years' War, Frederick turned his attention to domestic reforms. He implemented a series of modernization reforms in Potsdam, including abolishing torture, reforming the judicial system, promoting religious tolerance, and encouraging agricultural and industrial development. He established the Prussian Academy of Sciences and supported scientific research and cultural development. Frederick also implemented compulsory education, making Prussia one of the first countries in the world to do so. He personally inspected various regions to understand the people's conditions and often referred to himself as 'the first servant of the state'. During this period, Prussia's economy and culture developed significantly, administrative efficiency improved, and society became more stable. Frederick's model of enlightened absolutism became a model for European countries, and his concept of 'enlightened absolutism' influenced the political development of the entire continent.

points.title: 文化象征
points.description: 无忧宫是腓特烈大帝最喜爱的夏宫，也是他个人生活和艺术创作的中心。这里收藏了大量艺术品，腓特烈亲自参与园林设计，体现了他的艺术品味。腓特烈是一位多才多艺的艺术家，擅长演奏长笛，创作了多部音乐作品和文学作品。他在无忧宫接待了伏尔泰等众多欧洲知识分子，使这里成为欧洲启蒙运动的重要中心。腓特烈晚年更加关注艺术和文化，将普鲁士建设成为欧洲的文化中心之一。无忧宫不仅是腓特烈个人品味的体现，也象征着他作为'哲学家国王'的理想，将艺术、文化与政治统治完美结合，成为后世启蒙君主的典范。
points.descriptionEn: Sanssouci was Frederick the Great's favorite summer palace and also the center of his personal life and artistic creation. It housed a large collection of artworks, and Frederick personally participated in the garden design, reflecting his artistic taste. Frederick was a versatile artist, skilled in playing the flute, and composed numerous musical works and literary works. He received many European intellectuals such as Voltaire at Sanssouci, making it an important center of the European Enlightenment. In his later years, Frederick paid more attention to art and culture, making Prussia one of the cultural centers of Europe. Sanssouci not only reflected Frederick's personal taste but also symbolized his ideal as a 'philosopher king', perfectly combining art, culture and political rule, becoming a model for later enlightened monarchs.

appraisal.zh: 腓特烈大帝在史学与流行文化中形象复杂：他既是军事天才，也是推行司法改革、宗教宽容与义务教育的开明君主，还以文化赞助人和哲学家的身份留下印记，「国家第一仆人」与无忧宫分别象征其统治理念与艺术品味。但悬殊在于，他本质上是权力不受制约的专制君主，频繁发动战争，七年战争带来巨大伤亡与损失，改革主要服务国家强权，对农民下层关怀有限，反犹政策亦存歧视，其开明专制终究是强权工具。
appraisal.en: Frederick the Great cuts a complex figure: a military genius and an enlightened monarch who reformed the judiciary, promoted religious tolerance and compulsory education, and left his mark as a patron and philosopher, with 'the first servant of the state' and Sanssouci symbolizing his rule and taste. Yet the gap is stark: he remained an absolute monarch whose power was unchecked, launched frequent wars—the Seven Years' War bringing vast casualties and losses—and his reforms chiefly served state power, with limited concern for peasants and discriminatory policies toward Jews; his enlightened absolutism was ultimately a tool of power.

supporter.zh: 腓特烈大帝被视为启蒙时代的理想君主，他将开明专制理念付诸实践，推动了普鲁士的现代化进程。他废除酷刑、改革司法、促进宗教宽容，建立了世界上最早的义务教育制度之一。作为军事天才，他领导普鲁士崛起为欧洲强国，同时作为'国家第一仆人'，他关心民生，重视农业和工业发展。腓特烈还是一位多才多艺的艺术家，将普鲁士建设成为欧洲文化中心之一。他的统治模式成为后世启蒙君主的典范，对欧洲政治发展产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Frederick the Great is regarded as the ideal monarch of the Enlightenment era, putting the concept of enlightened absolutism into practice and promoting the modernization of Prussia. He abolished torture, reformed the judiciary, promoted religious tolerance, and established one of the world's first compulsory education systems. As a military genius, he led Prussia to rise as a European power, while as 'the first servant of the state', he cared for the people's livelihood and valued agricultural and industrial development. Frederick was also a versatile artist, making Prussia one of Europe's cultural centers. His model of rule became a paradigm for later enlightened monarchs and had a profound impact on European political development.

critic.zh: 批评者认为腓特烈大帝的统治存在严重局限性。他虽然倡导启蒙思想，但本质上仍是专制君主，权力不受制约。他频繁发动战争，尤其是七年战争给普鲁士和欧洲带来了巨大灾难，造成大量人员伤亡和经济损失。腓特烈对农民和下层民众的福祉关注有限，他的改革主要服务于国家利益而非人民福祉。此外，他的反犹政策和对宗教少数群体的态度虽有进步性，但仍存在歧视。腓特烈的军事扩张也破坏了欧洲的均势，引发了更多冲突，他的'开明专制'实际上是一种服务于国家强权的工具。
critic.en: Critics argue that Frederick the Great's rule had significant limitations. Although he advocated Enlightenment ideas, he was essentially an absolute monarch whose power was not checked. He frequently initiated wars, especially the Seven Years' War, which brought great disaster to Prussia and Europe, causing numerous casualties and economic losses. Frederick paid limited attention to the welfare of peasants and lower classes, and his reforms mainly served state interests rather than people's well-being. Additionally, his anti-Semitic policies and attitude towards religious minorities, though progressive, still contained discrimination. Frederick's military expansion also disrupted the balance of power in Europe, triggering more conflicts, and his 'enlightened absolutism' was essentially a tool serving state power.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，腓特烈大帝被复杂而多维地定义。他既是军事天才、开明君主，也是文化赞助人和哲学家。历史学家认为他代表了18世纪欧洲专制君主与启蒙思想的独特结合，他的统治既有专制的一面，也有进步的一面。流行文化中，他常被描绘为'老弗里茨'的形象，既是普鲁士军国主义的象征，也是启蒙思想的代表。他的名言'国家第一仆人'体现了其统治理念，而无忧宫则成为他个人品味和艺术追求的象征。腓特烈大帝的一生展现了个人才能与历史机遇的复杂互动，成为理解18世纪欧洲政治文化转型的重要案例。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Frederick the Great is defined in a complex and multidimensional way. He is seen as both a military genius and enlightened monarch, as well as a cultural patron and philosopher. Historians consider him a unique combination of 18th-century European absolutism and Enlightenment thought, with his rule having both autocratic and progressive aspects. In popular culture, he is often depicted as the figure of 'Old Fritz', symbolizing both Prussian militarism and Enlightenment ideas. His famous quote 'the first servant of the state' reflects his ruling philosophy, while Sanssouci has become a symbol of his personal taste and artistic pursuits. Frederick the Great's life demonstrates the complex interplay between individual talent and historical opportunity, becoming an important case for understanding the political and cultural transformation of 18th-century Europe.

self.zh: 我必须统治，因为这是我的责任；我必须服务，因为这是我的义务。
self.en: I must rule because it is my duty; I must serve because it is my obligation.
